author: H2G_
body: Hi!  I have been playing Avicus since it was MC Zone.  I just logged on today to see that I was banned?  I have no idea why, but it says that I was hacking.  I wouldn't hack on this server.  My older brother who uses this account may, but I will make sure that he doesn't do it again. I am very upset that I was banned.  Is there any way that I could get an un-ban?
